sources.author: ggyasin-morphe-patches
patch_list: Stops the loading screen waiting for Firebase/Remote Config and country lookup, and initializes ads in the background. Network requests may continue after startup.
Stops the in-house ad from opening the Play Store when tapped, so an accidental click does not leave the game. The ad and its close button are otherwise unchanged.
Stops Offline Games from requesting rewarded ads, so the game always falls back to its own in-house ad. Banners and interstitials are untouched.
Shows the house-ad close button on opening, hides the countdown, and initializes its counter as complete. Loads patched native code for mounted installs.
